title: What is the telephone number for the school with the lowest average score i
question: What is the telephone number for the school with the lowest average score in reading in Fresno Unified?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T3.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
INNER JOIN SchoolContact AS T3 ON T1.cds = T3.CDSCode
WHERE T2.`District Name` LIKE 'Fresno Unified%'
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1
